question: In a certain code language, ‘NATION’ is written as ‘RZLRQM’ and 'MARINE' is written as 'SZNRRV'. How will ‘ADVICE’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘NATION’ is written as ‘RZLRQM’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc46bca1cf6f363d256f1a870b1f3ac322ff536f237058412fee0b05fd9c126d.png] 

And,

'MARINE' is written as 'SZNRRV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c982516505fb593138d77e3fa4049b89700fa83ef675e4f2ff29a2d42d24e000.png] 

Similarly,

‘ADVICE’ is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cfc517fdbf0f126f53ae039c5f09f4e6d6eba732c656c728c22c3d0ec9501df.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
